name: iwomc
description: IWOMC Rescue - make a teammate's broken checkout runnable from a verified environment contract.

scripts.build:hosted: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:console
scripts.pack:cli: pnpm run build:hosted && pnpm run package:cli && npm pack ./release/iwomc
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @iwomc/console run typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && vitest run --project e2e
scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:console && pnpm run trace && pnpm run honesty && pnpm run secret-scan && pnpm run capability-matrix:check && vitest run
